name: Font Awesome UI
description: Integrates the Font Awesome icon library (CDN or local) with admin settings, an icon manager and a Drush downloader.
project_description:
The Font Awesome UI Icon Builder module provides a visual environment for selecting and customizing Font Awesome Icons with various features such as animation, border + pull, size, color, rotation, and flip. This module enables users to effortlessly and swiftly utilize Font Awesome Icons on their Drupal sites, enhancing the overall user experience and site design.

 Overview 
 Take the hassle out of icons in your Drupal website! 
 This module is currently under development. You can use the development version and provide your feedback and issues in the Issue section. If you're interested in collaborating on its development, please let me know!

 Requirements 
 
 Font Awesome (Library) 
is the Internet's icon library and toolkit, used by millions of designers, developers, and content creators. 
 
 Download Font Awesome Latest Version for FREE from GitHub.

 Support 
 Please let me know if a new feature is needed or if there are any issues and feedback. You can announce it in the Font Awesome UI Issues section.

 Font Awesome UI Icon Builder 1.0.0-RC5 is here! 
 This release introduces full support for Font Awesome 7 , bringing you the newest icons, designs, and packs — all integrated into your Drupal site with ease. Additionally, several improvements have been made, including fixing the vertical tabs issue in the settings form, resolving errors when library files are restricted, and optimizing functions for compatibility with the latest Font Awesome changes.

 
 Font Awesome 7 
 Icons. Easy. Done. 

 The internet's favorite icon library just expanded the menu. New designs. New packs. Millions of possible icons.

 
 Get Started with Font Awesome 
 The easiest way to get icons on your website is with a Kit. It's your very own custom version of Font Awesome, all bundled up with only the icons, tools, and settings you need.
